descriptions.code: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for TasksNearMe Staff.
descriptions.setup_code: Staff tools need a second step: a code from an authenticator app on your phone. Enter the setup code an admin gave you to start.
descriptions.enroll: Use an app like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.

setupCodeHint: It looks like K7QD-29XM-PR and works once, for 24 hours. Ask an admin if you don't have one.

enroll.add: Add an account with the key below, or open the link on this phone.
enroll.codeHint: The first code from your app confirms it.

devCode: Development only: the code 123456 also works here.

previews.dev: Staff sign-in: development, set up later
